newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Infrastructure Trust raises A$39.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Infrastructure Trust raises A$39.8 mln.

text.p: Infrastructure Trust of Australia Group said on Friday it had raised A$39.8 million through a placement of 31.8 million stapled securities at A$1.25 each.
The Trust said the securities had been placed with a range of institutional investors both in Australia and overseas.
The additional capital was raised in light of a number of bids currently in place for infrastructure assets, it said.
By 10.30 a.m. (0030 GMT), Infrastructure trust securities were three cents lower at A$1.27 on two trades totalling 8,000 securities.
